payload.claim: The ephemeral read command hardcodes the literal "/work" inside the shell string `'cd /work && exec "$@"'` instead of interpolating the module's own `WORKTREE_MOUNT` constant, even though the very next line and the docstring above both name `WORKTREE_MOUNT` as the target directory. Every other place in this file that needs this path in a shell string (e.g. line 68's `f"cd {WORKTREE_MOUNT} && ..."`) builds it from the constant rather than restating the literal, so this is a constant restated rather than imported — a defect even though the two values agree today, and a comment ('That container changes to `WORKTREE_MOUNT` itself') that no longer matches what the code actually does.
